caption: Frozen transfer and erasure-rank sensitivity. Every map is fitted once on the donor's in-distribution training split (fitting seeds 0--4) and applied unchanged to the MTEB targets; nothing is refitted on a target. (A) Change from Raw in the equal-weight mean nDCG@10 over the five legal retrieval tasks (AILACasedocs, AILAStatutes, LegalBenchConsumerContractsQA, LegalBenchCorporateLobbying, LegalSummarization); (B) change in STSBenchmark cosine Spearman. Donors are the primary settings: CAP (three sources), three-source SCOTUS and three-language SwiLTra with E5-small, and CAP and three-source SCOTUS with MiniLM. Points are changes in the seed-averaged score; bars are paired 95\% percentile bootstrap intervals (10{,}000 resamples, conditional on the frozen maps). The same resampled queries or sentence pairs serve every method and seed; the two AILA tasks share their 50 queries and are resampled jointly by query ID; STS Spearman is recomputed for each seed within every resample and then averaged over seeds. (C) Original-donor rank sweeps: legal macro change against the number $r$ of removed principal components, for the original donors CAP, binary SCOTUS Oyez--Lexis and binary SwiLTra DE--FR (not the three-class settings of A--B), at the evaluated ranks only, with the same paired bootstrap intervals. $k$-means LEACE uses the training-silhouette $K$; SAE-LEACE $N{=}32$; only Metadata-LEACE uses confounder labels. Displacement-matched PCA removes the fewest leading principal components whose displacement of the donor's training embeddings reaches that seed's SAE-LEACE map (ranks: E5-small CAP 20--21, SCOTUS 22, SwiLTra 22--23; MiniLM CAP 18--19, SCOTUS 20). An interval that includes zero does not show that a method is harmless or equivalent to Raw.
